description:
Frosty Snowflakes: Why No Two Snowflakes Are Ever Identical! — Look at that falling snow! But wait... is it true that no two snowflakes in the whole world are ever identical?
Kids science answer for "snowflake science for kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

High in freezing clouds, water vapor freezes around a tiny speck of dust into a six-sided ice crystal. As it falls through ever-changing humidity and wind, each snowflake grows its own unique microscopic branches!

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!

Sources & Fact Check:
